modelPlan.focus: Evaluate the impact of language trends on cultural and global communication.
keyArguments: The rise of globally spoken languages promotes international communication and understanding but may lead to language attrition and cultural erosion.
The decline of less widely spoken languages can threaten linguistic diversity and cultural heritage, but it can also encourage the revitalization and preservation efforts of endangered languages.
